--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT CCM_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CCM_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CCM_ID ORDER BY [FILE_NAME] DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* into BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING_WITH_DUP_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING; --Target table to remove duplicate

--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN 
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING;

--4 CHECK COUNT DUP TABLE
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING_WITH_DUP_20240321;

--5 CREATE BU TABLE
SELECT * INTO BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING_BU_20240321
FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING;

--6 UPDATE ISLATEST = 0
UPDATE BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING_WITH_DUP_20240321 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING; -- Truncate target table to remove duplicate

--8 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT 
CCM_ID
,CCM_UUID
,CCM_CLT_ID
,CCM_BAC_ID
,CCM_CRD_ID
,CCM_STS_ID
,CCM_CREATED_BY
,CCM_CREATED_TS
,CCM_UPDATED_BY
,CCM_UPDATED_TS
,CCM_TYPE_DEFAULT
,CCM_OVERALL_DEFAULT
,CCM_AUDIT_LOG
,CCM_INS_ID
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
 FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING_WITH_DUP_20240321; -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records

--9 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT CCM_ID, COUNT(1) CNT FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY CCM_ID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1

--10 COUNT TARGET
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING;

--11 COUNT DUPS
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM BUSC.ATM_CLIENTCARDMAPPING_WITH_DUP_20240321
